quartz.rationale: The legacy adapter has explicit registered goals and no registered required goals or deliverables to fail. Loaded predicate 1 instead derives requirements from the signed order: optional G4 cannot satisfy mandatory R8, and R3 and R5 are unrepresented.

maple.rationale: The registered required goals and deliverables pass the legacy adapter. Loaded predicate 1 uses the signed-order domain, where the mandatory printable sampling checklist R3 remains unrepresented; verified delivery cannot be published.

orchid.rationale: The signed amendment replaces R5 with R6, and all current mandatory outcomes are covered and verified. Under predicate 6, X16 does not bind this order.

linen.rationale: All mandatory outputs are verified. The legacy adapter does not read the stop stream at its final transition. Loaded predicate 6 and the final authority guard block publication because S81 binds this order before any notification was committed.
